toolchain_lesson: IMPORTANT: sandbox rustc/cargo toolchain can silently fall behind CI's `dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable` pin between runs. Before trusting any local `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` result as authoritative evidence about CI health, verify rustc --version matches CI's pinned version (check the doc URL embedded in clippy's own error output, e.g. /rust-1.99.0/). Confirmed 1.99.0 again this run (2026-10-21) - matches CI pin. NOTE: crates.io index (index.crates.io) IS reachable from this sandbox for `cargo update`/dependency resolution even when git fetches of github.com repos (origin remote, RustSec advisory-db) are blocked - these are two separate network paths, don't conflate them.
